summary: R312 is a narrow Paper 30 source-facing repair on top of R311. It restores R311's editorial `Durch Multiplikation` normalization back to source-visible `Duch Multiplikation` on printed p.52, and repairs the printed-p.54 product for `\ma` by restoring source-visible barred terminal index notation `\mbar{\mpideal}_{\bar r}^{\sigma_{\bar r}}`. The cumulative German TeX/PDF builds with XeLaTeX and remains 474 pages.
global_caveat: Targeted Paper 30 support only. The staged source pages are best-available native400-ish witnesses; 650/1000-equivalent images are readability aids only. This is not Paper 30 certification, Noether closure, multilingual synchronization, whole-corpus source closure, or critical-edition material.
